description: eugr's (Eugene Rakhmatulin) spark-vllm-docker recipes qwen3.8-flash-next-nvfp4-solo and -cluster for local-inference-lab's Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 (quantization-aware-distilled ModelOpt export, NVFP4 experts with MXFP8 attention; Qwen Community licence, informational; checkpoint revision 7c4f1bc1, about 106 GB of weights) served by vLLM on a single Spark. Runs eugr's published vllm-node-b12x image (--exp-b12x lane, nightly-20260929, digest pinned; its build-metadata records spark-vllm-docker 42f62e34, vLLM local-inference-lab/vllm dev/karmic-kraken 0296a817, FlashInfer 4a638133 and b12x master) with upstream's launch: the b12x kernel stack (b12x model loader, linear, MoE and gated-delta-net decode kernels, modelopt_mixed quantization, bfloat16 dtype, FP8 KV cache, block size 16, mamba cache mode align), MTP with four speculative tokens, chunked prefill, prefix caching, qwen3 reasoning and qwen3_xml tool parsing, multimodal encoder tensor-parallel mode data, FlashInfer autotune off, act-quant fusion compilation pass, 262,144-token context and 4,096 batched tokens (upstream defaults), plus upstream's environment for the b12x stack. This is upstream's solo recipe (solo-only): PLE tables are offloaded to disk (VLLM_PLE_TABLE_MEMORY=disk), eight sequences and memory utilisation 0.8; upstream's changelog says the offload allows more than 1M tokens of KV cache while the model's maximum context stays 262,144. No upstream performance claims are recorded. Upstream repository MIT. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint.
title: Qwen3.8 Flash Next NVFP4 b12x vLLM single Spark (eugr)
